picks.title: Meta tries to scapegoat staff who downloaded torrents to spare execs
picks.excerpt: In the authors' book-piracy suit, Meta was ordered to name the executives who approved torrenting books for AI training; Meta argues nobody 'decided' to pirate books.
picks.rationale: A new court order in the authors' piracy suit: Meta must name the executives who approved torrenting books for AI training.

picks.title: Tomato Novels Announces Full Shutdown of All AI-Related Services
picks.excerpt: ByteDance-backed web-fiction platform Tomato Novel is shutting down its AI writing services and switching new low-level authors to full-work-completion signing after a flood of AI-generated serials; authors pushed back and some open-sourced their AI workflows.
picks.rationale: A major web-fiction platform is shutting down all of its AI writing tools and changing how it signs authors. This is a concrete policy change for serial writers.

picks.title: New literary prize Prix Pascal launches in France for manuscripts written with AI
picks.excerpt: A new French literary prize will recognise a manuscript written with artificial intelligence, requiring entrants to disclose the tools and methods used to produce their work.
picks.rationale: A new prize launch: France's Prix Pascal openly accepts AI-written manuscripts as long as entrants disclose their tools. This runs against the trend of prizes vetting entrants to exclude AI.

picks.title: "검색창서 책 펼친다"…밀리의서재, AI로 독서 진입 간소화
picks.excerpt: KT 밀리의서재가 검색 결과에서 도서 핵심을 요약해 보여주고 바로 독서·추천으로 이어지는 'AI 브리핑' 기능을 도입했다.
picks.rationale: A new feature release: Millie's Library (밀리의서재) now shows AI summaries of a book in search results and takes readers straight into reading.

picks.title: [Korean Startup Interview] Sodalive: Turning Finished Webtoon Characters into AI Creators
picks.excerpt: Sodalive is pivoting from its voice platform VoiceOn to turn official webtoon and web-novel characters into AI creators that keep producing content after a series ends.
picks.rationale: A new IP model: official characters from finished webtoons and web novels become AI creators that keep producing content after the series ends.
